reason: Zoho and Excel are free, but they only work if somebody types the receipts in, and nobody here does. My staff already dump everything in the Telegram group, so a bot that turns that into a sheet my accountant can open is worth $19. With the villa receipts the free 30 will be gone in a week or two, and I'd pay before the next month end.
objection: Will it actually read the handwritten nota from the warung and the rupiah transfer screenshots correctly? If I end up checking every row anyway, it's just another thing to babysit. I'm also not thrilled about plugging my Google account into a bot I've never heard of.
would_change_my_mind: If during the free 30 it gets totals wrong on the handwritten or Indonesian receipts and I have to fix them by hand, I'd drop it and go back to scrolling the chat at month end.
